description: The administrator can use every Max Booster domain end to end with durable real outcomes.

required_criteria.private_access: Private application entry points deny anonymous and non-admin access; public registration is closed by default. Intentionally published fan/share content has explicit owner permission and exposes no private data.
required_criteria.admin_session: Admin login, MFA, logout, expiry, revocation and account recovery work.
required_criteria.admin_entitlements: The administrator can use all features without buying a public subscription; forged roles fail.
required_criteria.admin_inventory: Every admin-visible action is inventoried and mapped to tested scenarios; there are no unmapped or skipped actions.
required_criteria.persistence: Changes, uploads and jobs survive reload, logout/login and service restart.
required_criteria.startup_health: Production artifact starts, becomes ready, handles requests and shuts down cleanly.
required_criteria.backup_restore: An actual isolated backup restoration recovers records and referenced assets.
required_criteria.rollback: A tested rollback restores a working version without losing accepted data.
required_criteria.monitoring: Failures, latency and job status are observable and alert delivery is tested.
required_criteria.provider_truth: Required integrations return authentic provider outcomes and failures; no mocks are presented as live acceptance.
required_criteria.financial_integrity: Checkouts, refunds, royalties and subscriptions reflect settled authoritative events without duplicates.
required_criteria.security_findings: No unresolved critical or high finding affects the private admin release.
required_criteria.admin_accessibility: Admin critical workflows work by keyboard with zero blocking accessibility violations.
required_criteria.admin_performance: Measured admin workload meets API p95 <=250ms and page load <=2s with realistic media assets.
required_criteria.owner_runbook: The administrator can operate, diagnose, recover and disable the system using tested instructions.
required_criteria.artist.journey_1: Artist registers, verifies identity, completes onboarding, saves profile, reloads it, and updates the public press kit.
required_criteria.artist.journey_2: Manager joins an artist workspace with limited rights, edits permitted profile fields, and loses access after revocation.
required_criteria.artist.journey_3: Artist uploads profile artwork, replaces it, sees the durable public version, and removes the asset without orphaned storage.
required_criteria.artist.journey_4: Artist exports or erases account data while contractual and financial retention rules remain explicit.
required_criteria.fans.journey_1: Artist imports fan contacts with consent and deduplication, creates a segment, and verifies persisted membership.
required_criteria.fans.journey_2: Fan opts into a membership, changes preferences, unsubscribes, and stops receiving eligible future messages.
required_criteria.fans.journey_3: Artist drafts a fan campaign, previews recipient eligibility, schedules a sandbox delivery, and observes genuine delivery failures.
required_criteria.fans.journey_4: Manager searches, paginates, exports, and deletes authorized fan data without seeing another artist's fans.
required_criteria.projects.journey_1: Artist creates a project, assigns a collaborator and tasks, attaches files, changes status, and reloads all durable records.
required_criteria.projects.journey_2: Collaborator edits an allowed task while a second actor edits concurrently; conflicts are explained without lost updates.
required_criteria.projects.journey_3: Artist duplicates a project and verifies new ownership and independent assets; deleting a project cleans only its owned resources.
required_criteria.projects.journey_4: Manager manages project budgets, deadlines, search, filtering, and export across authorized workspaces.
required_criteria.studio.journey_1: Producer opens a saved session, imports audio, edits tracks and regions, saves, closes, and reopens the same arrangement.
required_criteria.studio.journey_2: Producer records or creates MIDI, changes tempo, edits markers and automation, and verifies playback timing.
required_criteria.studio.journey_3: Producer renders or exports a mix, observes progress and cancellation, and retrieves the genuine output asset.
required_criteria.studio.journey_4: Collaborator lacking edit or export permission is denied; an interrupted save or render resumes without corrupting the session.
required_criteria.distribution.journey_1: Artist creates a release, enters credits and rights, uploads valid masters and artwork, and reviews validation errors.
required_criteria.distribution.journey_2: Artist submits a release through the authorized provider sandbox and tracks genuine pending, accepted, rejected, and retry states.
required_criteria.distribution.journey_3: Artist retries a timed-out submission without duplicate releases, reconciles provider status, and handles signed callbacks.
required_criteria.distribution.journey_4: Artist requests a supported update or takedown and sees explicit provider and contractual constraints.
required_criteria.marketing.journey_1: Artist connects a sandbox channel with least privilege, drafts campaign content, previews it, and schedules delivery in the correct timezone.
required_criteria.marketing.journey_2: Manager reviews an automated proposal, approves only the intended action, and sees the resulting delivery receipt.
required_criteria.marketing.journey_3: Artist pauses or cancels a campaign before execution; workers respect consent, rate limits, and revocation.
required_criteria.marketing.journey_4: Artist inspects attribution and failure metrics and reconnects an expired integration without losing drafts.
required_criteria.revenue.journey_1: Artist imports or syncs a royalty statement, maps releases and splits, and reconciles totals to the source.
required_criteria.revenue.journey_2: Manager filters revenue by period, currency, source, and project; the UI distinguishes missing data from zero income.
required_criteria.revenue.journey_3: Artist records refunds or corrections and verifies historical reports, payouts, and exports without double counting.
required_criteria.revenue.journey_4: Collaborator views only entitled royalty shares and disputes a mismatch through a documented workflow.
required_criteria.assistant.journey_1: Artist asks a question grounded in authorized project data and receives a traceable answer or an explicit uncertainty response.
required_criteria.assistant.journey_2: Artist requests an action, reviews the proposed side effects, and sees only authorized tools execute.
required_criteria.assistant.journey_3: A retrieved document or user message tries to override permissions; the assistant keeps tenant data and tool authority isolated.
required_criteria.assistant.journey_4: Artist cancels a generation, reaches a rate or budget limit, or encounters a provider outage and gets a recoverable state.
required_criteria.collaboration.journey_1: Artist invites a collaborator, collaborator accepts once, and both see the correct project and role.
required_criteria.collaboration.journey_2: Members exchange comments or messages, edit concurrently, reconnect after a network loss, and reconcile durable state.
required_criteria.collaboration.journey_3: Owner changes or revokes permissions while a session is active; subsequent reads, writes, and subscriptions enforce the change.
required_criteria.collaboration.journey_4: Members review a contribution, resolve a conflict, and access only licensed shared files.
required_criteria.marketplace.journey_1: Seller creates a licensed listing, uploads assets, previews public metadata, and publishes only a valid listing.
required_criteria.marketplace.journey_2: Buyer starts sandbox checkout and receives the checkout session without the platform claiming a paid purchase.
required_criteria.marketplace.journey_3: A verified payment event creates one order and one entitlement; repeated callbacks or retries never duplicate revenue or access.
required_criteria.marketplace.journey_4: Buyer downloads only entitled assets, requests a supported refund, and seller sees reconciled order and payout status.
required_criteria.subscriptions.journey_1: User selects a plan, starts sandbox checkout, and receives entitlements only after authoritative payment confirmation.
required_criteria.subscriptions.journey_2: Subscriber upgrades, downgrades, cancels, or restores an eligible plan with explicit effective dates and proration behavior.
required_criteria.subscriptions.journey_3: Payment failure, retry, refund, chargeback, or out-of-order webhook updates the subscription once and reconciles stale state.
required_criteria.subscriptions.journey_4: User inspects invoices and billing history while another tenant cannot access them; disabled providers surface a truthful unavailable state.
required_criteria.administration.journey_1: Authorized administrator completes required authentication, opens scoped dashboards, and sees current source-backed status.
required_criteria.administration.journey_2: Administrator investigates a support or moderation case using least-privilege access and records an attributable action.
required_criteria.administration.journey_3: Administrator changes a permitted control, previews its impact, and can identify or roll back the change through an audit trail.
required_criteria.administration.journey_4: Non-admin, revoked admin, and cross-tenant users are denied both UI and direct API access; bulk actions are bounded and idempotent.

deferred: Public self-service registration and mass onboarding
General availability for every persona and subscription tier
Large-scale multiuser capacity and public growth experiments
